brief:
Palestinian actors in Gaza are staging theatrical performances that dramatize experiences of siege and loss while navigating the same dangers and deprivation depicted on stage, Al Jazeera English reported. The productions transform personal testimonies of conflict into live performances, allowing performers and audiences to process collective trauma through art.

The theatre works operate amid continued hardship, with actors confronting real threats and material scarcity even as they rehearse and perform scenes of destruction and displacement. The productions serve as both artistic expression and survival mechanism for a population still enduring the conditions their characters portray.
dek: In Gaza, Palestinian actors turn stories of siege and loss into theatre, while confronting the same fears and hardships.
title: Gazans act out their ongoing war in defiant theatre productions
